messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
